plan:
## Final Experiment Design — QuaRot W4A4 vs FP16 on LLaMa-2 prefill and decoding

### 1. Objective
Quantify how QuaRot's end-to-end 4-bit (W4A4) quantization changes the prefill and decoding performance of LLaMa-2 relative to an FP16 baseline, at 7B and 13B, with 5%/10%/2× meaningful-impact thresholds for prefill, decode, and memory respectively. Prefill and decoding are judged on their own metrics (TTFT and TPOT) and then composed into an end-to-end number; the headline split is always prefill vs decode, never blended.

### 2. Models
- LLaMa-2 7B (primary).
- LLaMa-2 13B (primary).
- LLaMa-2 70B: out of primary scope, recorded as a future-extension footnote (§12).

Model revisions are pinned to the Meta-released checkpoints (no fine-tunes), keeping the comparison one of quantization, not of checkpoint.

### 3. Conditions (paired within model)
| ID | Weights | Activations | KV-cache | Role |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C0 | FP16 | FP16 | FP16 | Baseline control. |
| C1 | 4-bit (GPTQ-on-rotated path or RTN matching QuaRot pre-rotation) | FP16 | FP16 | Attributing reference (weight-only). |
| C2 | QuaRot: 4-bit on rotated weights + learned clipping | 4-bit on rotated activations + paper's clipping | FP16 | Main condition of interest. |

Documented qualifier carried on every C2 headline number (per U2 / Q1): the paper retains a small set of outlier channels in higher precision; the cell reports the share explicitly so the headline claim has the same scope as the paper.

One-line justifications:
- C0 is the only behaviorally clean control.
- C1 isolates weight-only quantization so a C2 vs C1 contrast attributes the residual effect to activation 4-bit.
- C2 is the condition the question is about.

### 4. Workloads (prefill cleanly separated from decoding)
4.1 Prefill-only — prompt lengths {256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192} tokens; max_new_tokens=1, greedy decoding so prefill dominates cell time; TTFT measured via cuda.Event at the prefill-to-decode boundary.
4.2 Decode-only — fixed prefill context = 512 tokens; generation lengths {64, 256, 512}; TPOT = (end-to-end − TTFT) / N; aggregate tokens/s reported as the secondary metric (per U3).
4.3 Long-context sweep — prompt lengths {4096, 8192, 16384}-after-truncation within LLaMa-2's 4096 trained window; same TTFT gating with one sanity decode cell at one batch setting.
4.4 Mixed serving cell — small Cartesian {256, 1024, 4096} prompt × {64, 256} generation × batch {1, 4, 8} (16 if VRAM allows); identical prompts/seed across conditions.

### 5. Datasets and Splits
5.1 Calibration — WikiText-2 train (~256–512 sequences at natural length). Used only for C1's GPTQ path and C2's rotation + clipping search. Calibrated once per (model, condition) and cached.
5.2 Prefill evaluation prompts — WikiText-2 raw test, deduplicated, sliced at token boundaries to the target length. Strictly disjoint from calibration. ~32 prompt IDs per length cell, fixed across conditions. Optional secondary: ~32 C4-streaming prompts.
5.3 Decoding evaluation prompts — WikiText-2 test, fixed 512-token context, same prompt IDs across conditions.
5.4 Quality guardrails — WikiText-2 test perplexity as the primary quality anchor; lm-eval-harness zero-shot subset (HellaSwag, ARC-Easy, PIQA, WinoGrande) as the generative-quality probe. Both are labeled guardrails.

Calibration/evaluation separation is enforced by an explicit file-list diff check (§9.5).

### 6. Measurement Protocol
6.1 Hardware — Single high-end GPU (NVIDIA A100 80GB or H100). CUDA 12.x. One GPU per cell, conditions sequential. Disk <200 GB local; RAM 64 GB+ recommended.
6.2 Software — PyTorch with FlashAttention-2 or SDPA, identical kernel stack across C0/C1/C2 (hard requirement). Transformers + the published QuaRot reference implementation for rotation, learned clipping, GPTQ-on-rotated-weights, and outlier retention. Both are required at execution and absent here.
6.3 Warmup — 5 untimed calls per cell, two including tokenization so KV-cache allocation is steady-state.
6.4 Timed runs — 30 timed measurements per cell per (model, condition, batch, length); median, p95, IQR.
6.5 Counters — TTFT (ms), TPOT (ms/token), aggregate tokens/s, peak allocated GPU memory (MiB), peak reserved GPU memory (MiB), prefill-only wall-time, decode-only wall-time, end-to-end wall-time. Optional torch.profiler on one representative cell per (model, condition) for kernel attribution.
6.6 Determinism — torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG set, fixed seeds, greedy decoding, identical tokenization, identical kernel stack, identical batch composition across conditions.
6.7 Pairing — same prompt IDs across C0/C1/C2 at each length/batch cell — every statistical test is paired by request id.

### 7. Analysis Plan
7.1 Paired tests — per request id, Δ = T_quant − T_fp16 across 30 measurements; primary test = paired Wilcoxon signed-rank; paired t-test on log-latency and a sign test as robustness checks.
7.2 Effect sizes — relative change rel = T_quant / T_fp16 − 1, median + IQR per cell; Cohen's d on log-latency (paired); peak memory ratio peak_mem_fp16 / peak_mem_quant (meaningful ≥2× per T3).
7.3 Decomposition across phases — always tabulate prefill (TTFT) and decode (TPOT, tokens/s) independently before any end-to-end number; end-to-end = TTFT + N·TPOT, both components broken out.
7.4 Sensitivity sweeps — TTFT vs prompt length; TPOT vs generation length and vs prompt context length; aggregate tokens/s vs batch size at a fixed context length; per-condition markers for T1/T2 thresholds.
7.5 Cross-model — 7B vs 13B: stack Δ-TTFT and Δ-TPOT as a function of prompt length and batch; checks the prior that W4A4's benefit scales with model size.
7.6 Quality guardrail analysis — Δ-perplexity on WikiText-2 test; Δ-accuracy per lm-eval task with the paper-relevant subset as a separate panel. Guardrails are labeled and not folded into the performance verdict.

### 8. Quality Guardrails
- WikiText-2 test perplexity reported for C0, C1, C2; expects sub-1-point Δ for C2 vs C0 on the paper's regime.
- lm-eval-harness zero-shot subset (HellaSwag, ARC-Easy, PIQA, WinoGrande) for C0, C1, C2.
- Guardrails are reported alongside performance; a guardrail breach is reported as such rather than as a reason to suppress performance numbers.

### 9. Feasibility
9.1 Hardware budget — 7B FP16 ~14 GiB; 13B FP16 ~26 GiB; 70B excluded (§12). W4A4 reduces weights and in-flight activations; KV-cache FP16 dominates transient VRAM. 80 GB-class fits both 7B and 13B at the largest planned length and batch.
9.2 Wall time (prior estimate, not measured) — 24–72 GPU-hours per model on A100, ~5–15× faster on H100. Depends on the workload matrix chosen at execution.
9.3 Disk and RAM — ~50 GB for 7B artifacts (FP16 + W4A16 + W4A4 + intermediate scale tensors); ~100 GB for 13B. 64 GB+ RAM recommended; 125 GB has headroom.
9.4 Threats to validity — (i) implementation drift from paper — pin recipe version; (ii) kernel-stack differences — lock FA-2/SDPA across conditions; (iii) calibration leakage — file-list diff in §9.5; (iv) single-checkpoint confounds — Meta-revision pin; (v) hardware variance — run conditions on the same physical GPU at contiguous times plus one verification rerun per representative cell; (vi) KV-cache quantization interactions — fixed FP16 per U1; +KV4 out of scope (§12); (vii) sampling determinism — greedy decoding, fixed seeds, deterministic algorithms.
9.5 Feasibility checks needed at execution (not run in this design) — (a) confirm /workspace expected checkpoint paths after staging; (b) confirm CUDA version + FlashAttention-2 import; (c) confirm a single FP16 forward pass for 7B and 13B at the largest prompt length fits the target VRAM envelope; (d) file-list diff between wt2.train.ids and wt2.test.ids with empty intersection; (e) smoke TTFT/TPOT measurement with small N confirming timings have non-trivial variance and are > 0.

### 10. Restated prior hypotheses (explicit priors; not measurements)
These restate the priors from the approved approach so the analysis can be checked against them. None of these is a measurement under this design.
- Prior H1 (prefill under W4A4): small or neutral effect at short prompts; modest positive effect at long prompts as activation bandwidth falls. Magnitude prior: 0–15% relative TTFT change at 7B for prompts ≥ 2k tokens; 13B may benefit slightly more.
- Prior H2 (decoding under W4A4): clearly positive on memory-bound regimes (long context, larger batch). Magnitude prior: aggregate throughput ~1.5×–3× FP16; TPOT reduction in the same ballpark.
- Prior H3 (W4A16 reference): smaller version of H2; small positive decoding effect, near-neutral prefill.
- Prior H4 (quality): Δ-perplexity sub-1 point on WikiText-2 test; lm-eval zero-shot subset will be noisy.

### 11. Meaningful-impact thresholds (fixed by prior approval)
- T1 Prefill: |Δ TTFT| ≥ 5% relative to FP16 = meaningful; below that, kernel / noise floor.
- T2 Decode: |Δ TPOT| ≥ 10% overall = meaningful; tighter ≥ 5% bar in clearly memory-bound cells (long context, batch ≥ 4).
- T3 Memory: ≥ 2× peak-memory reduction vs FP16 = meaningful W4A4 memory claim.

Sub-threshold deltas are reported but labeled within kernel/noise floor.

### 12. Out-of-scope extensions (documented, not executed)
- A. +KV4 cell — QuaRot's experimental 4-bit KV cache as an additional W4A4+KV4 condition. Out of primary scope per U1; not measured here.
- B. 70B — would require tensor-parallel across 2–4 A100/H100 80GB or an explicit offload strategy. Primary scope is 7B + 13B.
- C. Speculative decoding, paged KV, chunked prefill — orthogonal engineering choices; isolated by a fixed kernel stack per §6.2.
- D. Continuous-batching serving stacks (vLLM, TGI) — separate study, not in question's scope.
- E. Other model families (LLaMA-3, Mistral) — explicitly out of scope.

### 13. Documented qualifiers (carried on every headline number)
- Q1. "W4A4" matches the paper's definition, including the small set of outlier channels in higher precision; the cell reports the percentage of channels and parameters that are truly 4-bit.
- Q2. C1 is pinned to GPTQ-on-rotated-or-RTN as executed, recorded in the artifact manifest.
- Q3. Calibration data is fixed to WikiText-2 train; any deviation must be reported.
- Q4. Quality numbers are guardrails, not the answer.

### 14. Self-contained summary of resolved decisions
- U1 → KV-cache FP16 in primary matrix; +KV4 listed in §12.
- U2 → paper's W4A4 definition; FP16 outlier share is a documented qualifier (Q1).
- U3 → TPOT primary, aggregate tokens/s secondary, both reported (§4.2, §6.5, §7.3).
- U4 → 70B dropped from primary, listed in §12.
- U6 → WikiText-2 perplexity primary quality anchor; lm-eval zero-shot subset (HellaSwag, ARC-Easy, PIQA, WinoGrande) as guardrail (§5.4, §8).
- U7 → W4A16 cell kept as an attributing reference (§3).
- T1/T2/T3 → stand as proposed (§11).

Design only; no experiment was performed under this task.
